name: ansi_with_hidden_cursor
title: Hide the cursor for an expression

origin.description: Hide the cursor while expr runs. A function is called.

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: A value, or a function to call.

origin.details: Hides the cursor while the expression runs, then shows it. A non-terminal prints neither sequence.
